name: Fitter's Bench
purpose: this bench is for fitters who install reviewed components into the live cockpit.
concierge_blurb: Fitters take signed components and seat them precisely where they belong. Nothing is forced; everything is measured twice.
lessons_learned_for_next_agent: There is no fitter_role literal in the roster — the role string is 'designer/scene_fitter' and category is 'design_decoration'. A naive query for category=='fitter' returns zero. Use role-suffix matching. Also: last_fit_ts has no source jsonl yet, so I used a 2026-06-14 placeholder per the brief — future agents wiring a real fit log should overwrite that field.
